about_the_game:
Tankazooka is a single-player platformer where players follow a small tank travelling with its convoy when it rolls onto a landmine, gets blown up and breaks its sprockets. Now, the tank has to travel through different environments to catch up to its convoy, using its barrel gun to shoot and jump forward in a crumbling world being tarnished by war.

Traverse through the 3 different environments and try and get the fastest score you can. Discover short cuts, work out better strategies, but be careful not to fall and lose your progress.
